full_judgment: 2. The aforesaid Miscellaneous case was registered upon an application under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950. Pre-emptor claimed preemption of the transfer that took place by the kabala dated January 4, 1992 claiming to be a co-sharer. The Miscellaneous Case was filed on May 18, 1992 claiming to have the knowledge about the transfer on May 13, 1992. It may be mentioned certified copy of the kabala was obtained on May 17, 1992.
